text: Deadlines are a part of professional life, and handling them well is a valuable skill. Effective time management is the foundation. This means breaking large projects into smaller, daily tasks and using a calendar to schedule dedicated work blocks. Prioritization is equally important; identify which tasks are most critical and tackle those first, rather than getting lost in minor details. Additionally, practice scope management by being realistic about what can be achieved in the given time. If you see a problem coming, don’t stay silent. Early communication with your team or manager about potential delays or obstacles allows for adjustments, making the final rush far less stressful.
